# Skillscout

> Skillscout helps users and AI agents discover relevant skills through an official vendor skills directory, the Find Official Skills agent skill, and a Chrome extension that suggests skills for the current website.

## Use the Skillscout Skill

Use Skillscout's `find-official-skills` skill when a user asks for official AI agent skills for a company, product, domain, or task.

- [Skillscout Skill](https://skillscout.sh/official/skillscout/): Package overview, installation commands, and source links.
- [Agent-readable Manifest](https://skillscout.sh/official/skillscout/skillscout_skills_skillscout.md): Fetch as plain text to inspect the package and its individual skill.
- [Skill Instructions](https://github.com/ulyanas/skillscout-skills/blob/main/skills/find-official-skills/SKILL.md): Search workflow and result selection guidance.

If the skill is already installed, read its SKILL.md and follow the bundled search workflow. To install it when the user requests installation, run:

```bash
npx skills add ulyanas/skillscout-skills@find-official-skills -y
```

## Find Official Skills

Run these commands from the installed `find-official-skills` directory. Use `--remote` to search the current published Skillscout catalog.

Search by task, with a preference for a named vendor:

```bash
node scripts/search_skillscout_official.mjs "grafana dashboards" --owner grafana --remote --json
```

Search by a product's website domain:

```bash
node scripts/search_skillscout_official.mjs --domain firebase.google.com --remote --json
```

Retrieve the complete inventory for a vendor:

```bash
node scripts/search_skillscout_official.mjs --owner grafana --all --remote --json
```

For each recommendation, explain the skill's purpose and include its publisher, exact install command, and source link. Prioritize individual skills that fit the user's task. For a vendor inventory, report the total from the complete results and group useful starting points by use case. Check that each recommended result matches the requested vendor or domain. When a search yields zero relevant matches, report that outcome with its scope limited to the current Skillscout catalog.

For web-based discovery, open the [Official Skills Directory](https://skillscout.sh/official/) and search by vendor, product, or task. Share a search link such as [Grafana Skills](https://skillscout.sh/official/?q=grafana), with the query URL-encoded. Vendor pages link to agent-readable Markdown manifests containing package details, install commands, and source links.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://skillscout.sh/): Product overview, core value proposition, and the main call to install the Chrome extension.
- [Guides](https://skillscout.sh/guides/): Collection of articles about AI and agentic skills.
- [OpenSEO Agent Skills](https://skillscout.sh/guides/openseo-agent-skills/): Explains OpenSEO's nine agent skills for SEO workflows, the MCP setup behind them, and what each skill returns.
- [Figma AI Skills](https://skillscout.sh/guides/figma-ai-skills/): Explains Figma's Community catalog of AI skills for the Figma agent, five skills worth trying, and Figma's 35 official agent skills.
- [Obsidian Skills Tutorial](https://skillscout.sh/guides/obsidian-skills-tutorial/): Explains how Obsidian can work as project memory for AI agents and how Obsidian Skills keep vault edits consistent.
- [Agentic Resource Discovery](https://skillscout.sh/guides/agentic-resource-discovery/): Explains the ARD standard and shows how to find Skills, MCP servers, tools, and agents with GitHub Agent Finder, Hugging Face Discover, and gh skill.
- [AI Agent Skills for Product Marketing](https://skillscout.sh/guides/ai-agent-skill-product-marketing/): Explains how marketers can design a product skill, connect it to product access, publish it in skill marketplaces, earn visibility, and create a useful sharing loop.
- [Viral AI Agent Skills](https://skillscout.sh/guides/viral-ai-agent-skills/): Explains why Ponytail, Caveman, Grill Me, Find Skills, and other popular agent skills spread, what they do, and how to evaluate them.
- [Official AI Agent Skills Statistics](https://skillscout.sh/guides/official-ai-agent-skills-statistics/): Analyzes official skills by company, repos, skill themes, install signals, GitHub stars, and covered software segments.
- [Are AI Agent Skills Here to Stay?](https://skillscout.sh/guides/are-ai-agent-skills-here-to-stay/): Explains why AI agent skills are growing, where the format is going, and how free, official, and paid skills may evolve.
- [Lovable Skills for AI Builders](https://skillscout.sh/guides/lovable-skills-for-ai-builders/): Explains how to use Lovable skills with official vendor skills for SEO, auth, backend, analytics, payments, and observability.
- [What Is Hermes Agent?](https://skillscout.sh/guides/what-is-hermes-agent/): Explains Hermes Agent by Nous Research, supported models, official skills, and how Hermes skills work with other skill-aware agents.
- [What Is DeepSeek Harness? DeepSeek Agent Skills Explained](https://skillscout.sh/guides/deepseek-harness-agent-skills/): Explains DeepSeek's open agent runtime, its Cordis plugin architecture, the four runtime modes, and how its SKILL.md agent skills, discovery priorities, and official skills work.
- [AI Agent Skills Security](https://skillscout.sh/guides/ai-agent-skills-security/): Explains security risks with third-party skills, safer installation workflows, payment-related controls, and official-skill discovery.
- [How to Organize AI Agent Skills](https://skillscout.sh/guides/how-to-organize-agent-skills/): Explains how to keep one shared skill library across Claude, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot.
- [What Are AI Agent Skills?](https://skillscout.sh/guides/what-are-ai-agent-skills/): Explains what AI agent skills are, how they work, and why reusable workflows matter.
- [Catalog Coverage](https://skillscout.sh/#catalogsSection): Lists supported skill catalogs, including SKILLS.sh, ClawdHub, Skill.fish, and MCPMarket.
- [How It Works](https://skillscout.sh/#snapshot): Explains site detection, keyword extraction, skill ranking, and in-popup results for active browsing sessions.
- [Use Cases](https://skillscout.sh/#use-cases): Shows example workflows for development, project management, marketing, content creation, knowledge work, and customer support.
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/skillscout/nihcililjolbokbbbmdfhmhbemfefddo?utm_source=site): Install page for the Skillscout Chrome extension.

## Key Facts

- Product type: Official AI agent skills directory, discovery skill, and Chrome extension
- Primary function: Finds relevant agent skills by vendor, product, domain, task, or current website
- Launch status: Available on the Chrome Web Store
- Price: Free
- Website: https://skillscout.sh/
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/skillscout/nihcililjolbokbbbmdfhmhbemfefddo?utm_source=site
